title: RLVR is a Kernel, Not a Function: Statistical Inference for pass@$k$ Crossovers
abstract: arXiv:2609.22547v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) often improves pass@1 while falling behind its base model at larger sampling budgets $k$, a crossover read as evidence that RLVR only sharpens existing capability. We identify two limits to this reading. First, a visible crossing need not be statistically established: comparing models on the same prompts, we build confidence bands across sampling budgets $k$ that require evidence of both an early gain and a later loss. Across five public RLVR pairs no crossing is statistically established in the initial evaluations, while a 32k-token evaluation on fresh prompts locates a reversal with first loss between 11 and 61 samples; power analysis shows why failure to detect a crossing need not mean no crossing, and why more prompts can help more than more answers per prompt. translated_title: RLVR是核而非函数：关于pass@$k$交叉现象的统计推断
translated_abstract: 可验证奖励强化学习（RLVR）通常能提升pass@1，但在更大的采样预算$k$下却落后于其基础模型，这种交叉现象常被解读为RLVR只是锐化既有能力的证据。我们指出了这种解读的两个局限。首先，可见的交叉未必在统计上得到确立：通过在同一提示集上比较模型，我们构建了跨采样预算$k$的置信带，该置信带要求同时存在早期增益和后期损失的统计证据。在五个公开的RLVR模型对中，初始评估中没有任何交叉在统计上得到确立；而在新提示上进行的32k token评估则定位到了一个反转，其首次损失出现在11到61个样本之间。功效分析解释了为什么未能检测到交叉并不意味着交叉不存在，以及为什么增加提示数量比增加每个提示的回答数量更有帮助。其次，仅凭基础模型的成功率并不能决定RLVR对某个提示的作用：具有相同基础成功率的提示……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出跨采样预算$k$的置信带统计推断方法，发现五个公开RLVR模型对中观察到的pass@$k$交叉现象均未获得统计确立，从而挑战了“RLVR仅锐化既有能力”这一流行解读，并证明基础模型成功率不足以决定RLVR对提示的作用。
en_tdlr: By constructing confidence bands across sampling budgets $k$, this paper shows that observed pass@$k$ crossovers between RLVR models and their base models are not statistically established, challenging the popular interpretation that RLVR merely sharpens existing capability, and demonstrating that base success rate alone does not determine what RLVR does to a prompt.
